fishing.no_water: Your rod reaches no water here. Stand on the bank facing the water, or wade in.
fishing.swimming: You cannot fish while you swim. Wade in no deeper than your waist.
fishing.not_in_world: You have to be in the world to fish.
fishing.held: You cannot fish while you are held still.
fishing.not_ready: Your fishing is still being read. Try again in a moment.
fishing.no_rod: You need a fishing rod in your pack. Traders and fishers sell them.
fishing.rod_broken: Your fishing rod is broken. A fisher can mend it.
fishing.rod_gone: You no longer carry a fishing rod, so you stopped fishing.
fishing.no_rod_left: You have no whole fishing rod left, so you stopped fishing.
fishing.no_answer: Your game did not say where the water is. Try again.
fishing.moved: You moved away from where you stood, so you stopped fishing.
fishing.not_given: The catch could not be put in your pack. Tell the staff.
fishing.rod_broke: Your rod broke: {rod}. A fisher can mend it.
fishing.bait.title: Bait
fishing.bait.bare: You will fish with a bare hook.
fishing.bait.out: You have no {bait} left, so you cast with a bare hook.
